description: This file defines the TlsServerAuthenticationOptions class, which encapsulates SSL/TLS server authentication settings, including certificates, protocols, and callback configurations for Orleans connections security.

classes.name: TlsServerAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Encapsulates SSL/TLS server authentication options, exposing configuration parameters such as server certificate, certificate selection callback, protocols, and revocation mode.

methods.name: TlsServerAuthenticationOptions()
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the TlsServerAuthenticationOptions class with default protocols.

methods.name: ServerCertificate
methods.description: Gets or sets the server SSL certificate used for the TLS authentication.

methods.name: ServerCertificateSelectionCallback
methods.description: Gets or sets the callback delegate used to select the server certificate dynamically.

methods.name: ClientCertificateRequired
methods.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether client certificates are required.

methods.name: EnabledSslProtocols
methods.description: Gets or sets the SSL protocols enabled for the TLS handshake.

methods.name: CertificateRevocationCheckMode
methods.description: Gets or sets the revocation mode used during certificate validation.

methods.name: SslServerAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying SslServerAuthenticationOptions object.
